莉莉的生活方式(Lily's Way of Living): 一篇关于健康生活的B1记叙文:莉莉的经历、感受与成长。

Lily thanked Nina for the honest advice. On Monday evenings, Lily reviews the notes from class. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. The crossword setter devised another fiendish puzzle this week.

Lily ordered rice and water at the running track last night. People around Lily often share different ideas about the swimming pool. The experience taught Lily more than any book could. The surgeon put on a surgical mask.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Lily's dream job is to be a nurse. The running track has become an important part of daily life. She teaches a postcolonial literature course at the university.
At first, Lily found it difficult to keep the habit. Little by little, things began to change. Nina always says that small steps matter more than big plans. What is the height of that wall?
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Lily prefers sunny weather when running in the park. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
